title: Priority for Pioneer Generation Citizens Applying to Ballot for National Day Parade Tickets
what_it_is: Priority for Pioneer Generation Citizens Applying to Ballot for National Day Parade Tickets

sections.label: NDP ticket allocation for Singaporeans
sections.summary: About 165,000 Singaporeans can watch this year's NDP, but preferential Pioneer Generation ticket allocation would reduce other Singaporeans' chances.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: It is heartening that Singaporeans are eager to be part of the celebrations, with the number of ticket applications for NDP overwhelmingly exceeding the seats available each year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: This year, we expect about 165,000 Singaporeans to be able to watch the two previews and the parade on the actual day, or three times more than past NDPs, at the Marina Bay Floating Platform or the Padang.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Indeed, the Pioneer Generation should be honoured and thanked for their sacrifices, achievements and immense contributions for building the Singapore we know and have today.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: However, as a national celebration for all Singaporeans, it is important that every Singaporean be given an equal chance to attend the NDP.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: We are mindful that preferential allocation of tickets would not be in line with this intent to include all Singaporeans as part of the nation's birthday.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: To give greater priority to the Pioneer Generation, or about 450,000 Singaporeans, will lead to reduced chances for other Singaporeans.

sections.label: Balloting register for successful applicants
sections.summary: Since 2013, those successful in one year's balloting are removed from the register for the next year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: What we have done is that, since 2013, those who have been successful in balloting in one year are then taken off the register for the subsequent year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: So, we try to give opportunities for those who have not balloted successfully in one year to ballot again the next year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: Those who have been successful in that year will not be allowed to ballot again the next year.

sections.label: Fair balloting system for tickets
sections.summary: The current system is fair and will continue to give everybody an equal chance of being balloted for tickets.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: So, it will be very difficult to ascertain that.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: I think the system we have today is fair and we will continue to try to facilitate a fair system where everybody gets an equal chance of being balloted for the tickets.

sections.label: Access to NDP tickets
sections.summary: The aim is to give Singaporeans access to the NDP, with more chances this year because capacity is bigger.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: The point we recognise is that we want to give Singaporeans the opportunity to get access to the NDP.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: This year, for example, more will get a chance because the capacity is bigger, and we will look into the system and facilitate as much as we can.
